7.t: Operator Options To see the SELECT OPTIONS screen (Figure 2-7), return to the Self-Test Menu and select OPERATOR OPTIONS. To move to the next option, press the 1-player start switch. To select a new value, roll the Midi Trak-Ball™ Press the 2-player start switch to replace the old value with the new value. The SIGNATURE option allows the player with the highest score to sign his name using the Midi Trak- Ball™. His name and score are transferred into the high-score table. The entire high-score tabie is erased with the reset option. However, you may erase all except the three highest scores by turning the game off. To end the Self-Test, set the self-test switch to off.
